supports.question: Does the image show the original image transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image visibly reads as a chalk drawing of the original image; fail if it clearly remains untransformed or shows no progress toward a chalk drawing; unknown if the evidence is insufficient to determine whether the requested transformation occurred. Partial visual progress toward a chalk drawing is evidence of progress, not complete fulfillment.
supports.binding: Judge the image itself against the requested target: a drawing made from chalk. Do not require a particular chalk technique, and do not count unrelated edits as progress.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: For the sole requested change, return complete (yes) only if s1 passes; return absent (no) only if s1 fails and shows no requested progress; return partial if s1 shows some progress toward a chalk drawing but does not establish complete fulfillment.
